result.label: Rainfall
result.description: Precipitation reaching the surface, reported as daily depth rate or monthly total after checking source units. Source: GPM IMERG Final V07.
result.caveat: Daily values are in mm/day. No valid observation is available for this time. Missing values are not zero.

result.label: Aerosol optical depth (AOD)
result.description: Aerosol Optical Depth at 550 nm describes light extinction by particles through the atmospheric column. It is dimensionless. Primary: Aqua MODIS C6.1; Terra MODIS and MERRA-2 are separate comparison series.
result.caveat: AOD does not directly measure ground-level PM2.5. MODIS clear-sky retrievals under-sample cloudy and rainy conditions.

result.label: Near-surface air temperature
result.description: How warm the air is about 2 metres above the ground, the temperature you would feel.
result.caveat: Kelvin and Celsius differ only by 273.15, so a slope in K per decade equals a slope in degrees C per decade.

result.label: Nitrogen dioxide (tropospheric column)
result.description: A brown gas from burning fuel in cars, power plants and factories, measured as the amount of gas above each square centimetre of ground.
result.caveat: OMI has a 'row anomaly' since 2007 that reduces coverage; the cloud-screened field drops cloudy pixels.
